title: NeuralRAG
description: A production-grade retrieval-augmented generation system with a fine-tunable sentence transformer, FAISS retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, and a FastAPI server running Llama 3.2 locally.

title: AutoAgent
description: An autonomous ReAct agent with web search, Wikipedia, math, and sandboxed Python tools, plus short-term and long-term memory. Reaches 80%+ success across five task categories.

title: Sentinel
description: An end-to-end release validation harness for a live seven-service healthcare AI platform. Playwright-driven actors simulate clinical user journeys across WhatsApp and web chat before every production deploy.

title: Email Auto-Reply
description: A full-stack Flask and React app that parses incoming email and drafts context-aware replies through the OpenAI API. Processed 500+ threads and cut manual response time by roughly 70%.

title: Granny Green Acquisition Stack
description: A seven-device synchronized recording pipeline for an IRB-approved stress-recovery study: Polar H10 ECG, EmotiBit, a Vernier respiration belt, seven cameras, and multichannel audio, all streamed into PsychoPy over LSL.

title: Is Indulgence Rewarded?
description: A statistical investigation of 230,000 Food.com recipes asking whether richer recipes earn higher ratings. Includes missingness analysis, permutation testing, and a predictive model, published as a static site.

title: FIELD
description: A website concept for the UCSD XR Lab built on a biophilic nature palette, chosen from three competing design directions and carried through to a matching RA identification badge.

title: Hashing Study Guide
description: A typeset reference on hash tables, load factors, and collision resolution, written to match the exact question formats used on the DSC 40B final exam.

title: This Portfolio
description: A hand-written personal site with no framework: semantic HTML, a CSS grid layout with subgrid, an automatic navigation menu, a dark mode switch, and project cards templated from this very JSON file.

title: Collab Reel
description: A promotional edit cut in Final Cut Pro for a student organization collaboration, mixing handheld footage, motion graphics, and a music-driven cut structure.

title: Cognition Podcast
description: A recorded and edited audio piece translating cognitive science research into plain language for a general audience, produced for a UCSD course midterm.

title: Data Structures in Java
description: From-scratch implementations of linked lists, hash tables, heaps, and balanced trees with JUnit test suites, written while working through the DSC 30 sequence.
